notes: The two יהיה clauses are read differently on purpose: the first is the possessive recasting of rule 43 (ye shall have, with its ל unrepresented under rule 40), the second the presentative copula of rule 21 (it is), since there the ASV spends unto on the preposition.

באחד לחדש has no article morpheme, so the the of the first day is a supplied determiner joining the substantival numeral's unit under rules 15 and 31, while the bracketed article of לחדש takes its own written the.
כל plus לא share the single no under rule 35, headed on the negative.
